guideContent: 1. Start with short words to clear letters. 2. Look for common letter pairs. 3. Plan longer words for higher scores. 4. Use the center hex for maximum connections. 5. Focus on vowels first. 6. Practice your vocabulary daily. 7. Learn to spot word patterns in hex grids.

title: Farm Fresh Match
shortDescription: Match fresh produce in this farm-themed puzzle
description: Farm Fresh Match brings the charm of country living to match-3 gameplay! Match fresh fruits, vegetables, and farm animals in this delightfully wholesome puzzle game. With its cheerful graphics, relaxing soundtrack, and satisfying match mechanics, it's the perfect casual game for all ages.
instructions: Swap adjacent farm items to create matches of 3 or more. Complete farm orders to earn stars. Collect special items for bonus points.
guideContent: 1. Focus on order items first. 2. Create special items for tough spots. 3. Watch for falling items after matches. 4. Plan moves ahead. 5. Use boosters on hard levels. 6. Complete daily challenges for rewards. 7. Take your time - no rush!

title: Merge Cakes
shortDescription: Merge delicious cakes and pastries to create masterpieces
description: Welcome to Merge Cakes, the sweetest merge game on the web! Combine cupcakes, cakes, and pastries to create magnificent dessert masterpieces. With hundreds of items to discover, beautiful graphics, and satisfying merge chains, this game is pure sugary fun!
instructions: Drag matching desserts together to merge them into better treats. Fulfill customer orders to earn coins. Unlock new recipes and decorations.
guideContent: 1. Merge 5 items when possible for bonus. 2. Focus on high-value dessert chains. 3. Complete orders quickly for tips. 4. Decorate your bakery for more customers. 5. Unlock all recipes for achievements. 6. Save premium ingredients for events. 7. Serve customers efficiently.

title: Pyramid Solitaire
shortDescription: Clear the pyramid by pairing cards that sum to 13
description: Pyramid Solitaire challenges you to clear a pyramid of cards by pairing cards that add up to 13. With its unique gameplay mechanics and strategic depth, this solitaire variation offers a fresh challenge for card game enthusiasts.
instructions: Click on two cards from the pyramid or stock that add up to 13. Kings are removed singly (they count as 13). Clear all cards from the pyramid to win.
guideContent: 1. Clear top pyramid cards first. 2. Plan which cards to save. 3. Use the stock pile strategically. 4. Don't rush to remove easy pairs. 5. Think about what cards you need. 6. Clear blocking cards early. 7. Practice with the undo feature.

title: Garden Hidden Objects
shortDescription: Find hidden items in beautiful garden scenes
description: Explore enchanting gardens and discover hidden treasures in Garden Hidden Objects! Search through lush flower gardens, tranquil ponds, and magical greenhouses to find all the hidden items. A relaxing and beautiful hidden object experience.
instructions: Search the garden scenes for the listed items. Click on each item you find. Use the magnifying glass for detailed areas. Enjoy the peaceful garden atmosphere!
guideContent: 1. Start with a wide scan of the scene. 2. Look for item shapes and colors. 3. Check behind flowers and leaves. 4. Use hints when you're stuck. 5. Enjoy the scenery - it's part of the experience. 6. Play during breaks for relaxation. 7. Complete collections for bonuses.

title: Tower Defense
shortDescription: Build towers and defend your base from enemies
description: Strategically place towers to defend your base against waves of enemies in this classic Tower Defense game! Choose from various tower types, upgrade your defenses, and plan your strategy. With multiple maps and difficulty levels, this strategy game offers endless tactical fun.
instructions: Click on empty spaces to build towers. Select different tower types for different effects. Upgrade towers to improve their power. Survive all enemy waves to win the level.
guideContent: 1. Build at choke points first. 2. Balance tower types for different enemies. 3. Upgrade strategically, not randomly. 4. Learn enemy path patterns. 5. Save resources for crucial upgrades. 6. Use slowing towers near the start. 7. Place high-damage towers at the end.

title: Photo Puzzle
shortDescription: Slide tiles to reconstruct beautiful photos
description: Photo Puzzle is a sliding tile puzzle game featuring stunning photographs! Slide tiles to reconstruct beautiful images from around the world. Choose from 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 grid sizes. A relaxing puzzle game for art and photography lovers.
instructions: Click on a tile adjacent to the empty space to slide it into the empty space. Rearrange all tiles to reconstruct the original image. Track your moves and time.
guideContent: 1. Start with the top row. 2. Solve row by row from top. 3. Use the last two rows for the final section. 4. Practice the algorithm for rotating tiles. 5. Start with smaller grids. 6. Use the preview to check progress. 7. Take breaks for difficult puzzles.

title: Kitchen Dash
shortDescription: Cook and serve meals in a busy kitchen
description: Feel the heat in Kitchen Dash! Run a busy restaurant kitchen, cook meals, and serve hungry customers. With fast-paced time management gameplay, unlock new recipes and upgrade your kitchen. Can you handle the dinner rush?
instructions: Follow recipes to cook meals. Serve customers in order of arrival. Keep your kitchen clean and organized. Upgrade equipment for faster service.
guideContent: 1. Prep ingredients in advance. 2. Learn recipe timings. 3. Multi-task between stations. 4. Upgrade the stove first. 5. Keep ingredients stocked. 6. Serve in customer order. 7. Stay calm during rush hour.

title: Dots and Boxes
shortDescription: Connect dots to complete boxes and claim them
description: The classic pencil-and-paper game now in your browser! Connect dots with lines to form boxes. Complete a box to claim it and earn an extra turn. Challenge the AI or play with a friend in this timeless strategy game.
instructions: Click between two adjacent dots to draw a line. Complete the fourth side of a box to claim it. Claiming a box gives you an extra turn. Most boxes at the end wins!
guideContent: 1. Avoid creating chains of three sides. 2. Force your opponent to open boxes for you. 3. Sacrifice boxes strategically. 4. Count remaining moves. 5. Learn the double-cross technique. 6. Control the center of the board. 7. Practice endgame scenarios.

title: Monster Match
shortDescription: Match cute monsters in this adorable puzzle game
description: Monster Match is an adorable match-3 game featuring the cutest monsters you've ever seen! Match colorful monster tiles, collect special creatures, and explore a whimsical monster world. With charming artwork and fun power-ups, this game brings a smile to your face.
instructions: Swap adjacent monster tiles to match 3 or more. Collect special monsters for bonus points. Use monster power-ups to clear tough levels. Complete the monster collection!
guideContent: 1. Focus on collecting rare monsters. 2. Use power-ups wisely. 3. Complete daily missions for rewards. 4. Explore all monster worlds. 5. Combine special tiles for chain reactions. 6. Save boosters for hard levels. 7. Trade duplicate monsters with friends.

title: Space Blocks
shortDescription: Clear blocks in space with this cosmic puzzle
description: Space Blocks takes block puzzle gameplay to the cosmos! Place colorful blocks on a grid and clear lines in this addictive space-themed puzzle. With stellar graphics, gravity-defying gameplay, and cosmic sound effects, it's out of this world!
instructions: Drag blocks onto the grid. Complete full rows or columns to clear them. The game ends when no more blocks fit. Aim for combo clears for bonus points.
guideContent: 1. Plan for I-shaped blocks. 2. Keep the center open. 3. Use corners efficiently. 4. Clear multiple lines at once. 5. Stack blocks evenly. 6. Think about the next three blocks. 7. Practice makes perfect.

title: Color Sort
shortDescription: Sort colored liquids into the right bottles
description: Color Sort is a satisfying color-sorting puzzle game! Pour colored liquids between bottles until each bottle contains only one color. With hundreds of levels and increasing difficulty, this relaxing logic puzzle will keep your mind engaged and your stress levels low.
instructions: Click on a bottle to select it, then click on another bottle to pour. You can only pour into a bottle with the same color on top or an empty bottle. Sort all colors to complete the level.
guideContent: 1. Empty at least one bottle early. 2. Don't pour matching colors onto different colors. 3. Plan your moves ahead. 4. Use empty bottles as temporary storage. 5. Focus on one color at a time. 6. Restart if you get stuck. 7. Learn common patterns.

title: Jungle Treasure
shortDescription: Explore the jungle and find hidden treasure
description: Embark on a jungle adventure in search of hidden treasure! Explore lush jungle scenes, solve puzzles, and discover ancient artifacts. With beautiful hand-drawn artwork and immersive gameplay, Jungle Treasure is a relaxing adventure for explorers of all ages.
instructions: Search jungle scenes for hidden treasures and artifacts. Click on items to collect them. Solve simple puzzles to progress. Follow the treasure map!
guideContent: 1. Scan scenes thoroughly before clicking. 2. Look for items that match the silhouette. 3. Use hints when truly stuck. 4. Follow the story for clues. 5. Explore every corner of each scene. 6. Collect bonus items for extra points. 7. Enjoy the artwork!

title: Match Master
shortDescription: A fast-paced matching game for quick reflexes
description: Match Master tests your speed and observation! Find matching pairs of cards as quickly as possible. With multiple game modes, themed card sets, and competitive scoring, this fast-paced memory game will keep you on your toes.
instructions: Flip two cards at a time to find matching pairs. Match all pairs to complete the game. Beat your best time for stars. Unlock new card sets with high scores.
guideContent: 1. Use a consistent scanning pattern. 2. Verbalize card positions. 3. Focus on memorizing after each flip. 4. Practice speed gradually. 5. Play daily to improve. 6. Start with fewer cards. 7. Use the pause feature for mental breaks.

title: Ocean Merge
shortDescription: Merge sea creatures and build an underwater world
description: Dive into Ocean Merge, a relaxing underwater merge adventure! Combine sea creatures, coral, and treasure to build a vibrant ocean world. Discover rare marine life, complete collections, and create the most beautiful reef in the sea.
instructions: Drag matching sea creatures together to merge them. Discover new species through merges. Complete the ocean encyclopedia. Decorate your reef with special items.
guideContent: 1. Focus on chain merges for rare species. 2. Complete daily reef challenges. 3. Save premium items for special events. 4. Expand your reef gradually. 5. Collect all sea creatures for bonuses. 6. Join ocean events for exclusive items. 7. Share your reef with friends.

title: Candy Puzzle
shortDescription: Sweet puzzle challenges with candy pieces
description: Candy Puzzle combines the sweetness of candy with brain-teasing puzzles! Move candy pieces to fill the board and complete level goals. With its delightful candy theme, satisfying mechanics, and hundreds of sweet levels, this puzzle game is a treat!
instructions: Drag candy pieces to fill empty spaces. Complete row and column goals to pass levels. Special candies give bonus effects. Collect stars for achievements.

title: Circus Match
shortDescription: Step right up to this circus-themed match-3 game
description: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Circus Match! The greatest match-3 show on earth! Match colorful circus items, trigger spectacular chain reactions, and enjoy the carnival atmosphere. With its vibrant visuals and entertaining gameplay, the circus has never been this fun!
instructions: Swap adjacent circus items to create matches. Perform special tricks for bonus points. Complete circus acts to progress through the show.

title: Solitaire Golf
shortDescription: Clear the tableau in this fast-paced golf solitaire
description: Solitaire Golf combines the best of solitaire and golf! Clear cards from the tableau by selecting cards one higher or lower than the active card. Try to clear all cards in as few passes as possible. A perfect game for quick gaming sessions!
instructions: Click on cards one rank higher or lower than the waste pile card. Cards of any suit can be played. Clear all cards with as few stock passes as possible.

title: Animals Match
shortDescription: Match adorable animal pairs in this memory game
description: Animals Match is a delightful memory game featuring cute animal illustrations! Flip cards to find matching animal pairs. With multiple difficulty levels and adorable animal artwork, this game is perfect for kids and adults alike.
instructions: Flip cards to reveal cute animals. Remember their positions and find matching pairs. Match all pairs to win. Progress through levels with more cards.

title: Gem Merge
shortDescription: Merge precious gems to create legendary jewels
description: Gem Merge is a sparkling merge game where you combine precious gems to create legendary jewels! Start with small stones and work your way up to crown jewels. With beautiful gem graphics and satisfying merge chains, this game is a gem lover's dream.
instructions: Drag matching gems together to merge them into rarer stones. Complete jewel collections. Sell finished gems for coins. Unlock new gem types.

title: Word Cross
shortDescription: Fill the crossword grid with hidden words
description: Word Cross gives you a blank crossword grid and the words to fill it! Drag words into their correct positions to complete the puzzle. With its unique gameplay and thousands of puzzles, Word Cross is a fresh take on crossword puzzles.
instructions: Drag words from the word bank onto the grid. Words must cross at shared letters. Complete the grid to solve the puzzle. Use hints for difficult words.
